name: 認可地縁団体の印鑑手続きを変更
summary: 認可地縁団体の印鑑登録や証明書の交付などは、代表者が申請し、代理人による申請もできます。この議案では、職務代行者や代理人に関する規則の参照先と、代理申請できる場合の書き方を改めます。2026年10月1日に施行されます。
changes: 職務代行者と代理人に関する規則の参照先を改める
証明書の交付申請や印鑑登録の廃止・亡失の申請で、代理申請できる場合の書き方を改める
who: 町田市の認可地縁団体

en.name: Changes seal procedures for authorized neighborhood associations
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Machida City Seal Ordinance Concerning Authorized Neighborhood Associations
en.summary: For seal registration and the issuance of certificates for authorized neighborhood associations, the representative applies, and an agent may also apply. This bill revises the references to rules concerning persons acting in place of the representative and agents, as well as the wording on when an agent may apply. It takes effect on October 1, 2026.
changes: Revises the references to rules concerning persons acting in place of the representative and agents
Revises the wording on when an agent may apply for a certificate or apply to cancel or report the loss of a seal registration
who: Authorized neighborhood associations in Machida City
